title: Complete checkout with delivery details and payment selection
description: This test verifies that a shopper can enter delivery information, choose a payment method, and place an order successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Continue to checkout
Fill in the required delivery information
Select a QR Simple or Card payment option
Submit the order
Verify an order confirmation is visible
Verify the order was created

title: View live delivery progress and courier contact details
description: This test verifies that a shopper can open order tracking and see delivery progress, courier location visibility, and driver contact access.

steps.description: Navigate to /order/track/1
Verify delivery progress steps are displayed
Verify the courier marker is visible on the map
Verify a driver phone link is available

title: Create an order with delivery details and card payment
description: This test verifies that a shopper can complete checkout by entering delivery information, choosing card payment, and creating an order successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Fill in the customer name field with Alex Rivera
Fill in the phone field with 70000001
Fill in the delivery address field with Zona Equipetrol, Santa Cruz
Select card payment
Confirm the order
Verify the order is created
Verify a tracking view is available

title: Select a variant and add the product to the cart from the product page
description: This test verifies that a shopper can choose a variant on the product page and add the selected item to the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product card in the catalog
Select an available variant option
Add the product to the cart
Verify the cart reflects the added product
Verify the selected variant is preserved in the cart

title: Create an order with delivery details and QR Simple payment
description: This test verifies that a shopper can complete checkout by entering delivery information, choosing QR Simple payment, and creating an order successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Fill in the customer name field with Maria Gomez
Fill in the phone field with 70000002
Fill in the delivery address field with Zona Sopocachi, La Paz
Select QR Simple payment
Confirm the order
Verify the order is created
Verify a tracking view is available

title: Adjust cart quantities and remove an item
description: This test verifies that a shopper can change item quantities in the cart, see totals update, and remove the last item from the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Increase the quantity of an item in the cart
Verify the cart subtotal updates
Decrease the quantity of the same item
Verify the cart subtotal updates again
Remove the item from the cart
Verify the cart is empty

title: Add a new product to inventory
description: This test verifies that a vendor can open the add-product flow, enter required product details, save the product, and see it appear in inventory.
category: Vendor Inventory Management and Product Creation

steps.description: Navigate to /vendor/inventory
Open the add-product modal
Fill in the product title field with Golden Rice
Fill in the price field with 35
Fill in the stock field with 12
Save the product
Verify the new product appears in the inventory table
Verify the add-product modal is closed

title: Review live delivery progress and courier contact
description: This test verifies that a shopper can open live tracking for an active order, review delivery progress, and see the courier contact details.

steps.description: Navigate to /order/track/[id]
Verify delivery progress updates are displayed
Verify the courier contact card is displayed

title: Browse and filter the catalog by category and search
description: This test verifies that a shopper can narrow the home catalog by category and search and then restore the full product grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the category pill for Technology
Verify the product grid updates to matching items
Type a search term into the catalog search field
Verify the catalog updates to matching results
Clear the search field
Verify the full product catalog is restored

title: Show checkout validation for missing delivery details
description: This test verifies that checkout blocks submission and shows validation messages when required delivery fields are left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Confirm the order
Verify validation messages are visible for the missing required fields
Verify the order is not created

title: Add a new inventory item and see it appear in the table
description: This test verifies that a vendor can create a new product from the inventory modal and see it added to the inventory list.

steps.description: Navigate to /vendor/inventory
Open the add product modal
Fill in the required product fields
Save the new product
Verify the new product appears in the inventory table
Verify the inventory table remains accessible after saving

title: See the courier marker on the live map
description: This test verifies that the tracking page shows the courier location on the map for an active order.

steps.description: Navigate to /order/track/[id]
Verify the courier marker is displayed on the map
Verify live tracking information is displayed

Fill in the phone field with 70000004
Fill in the delivery address field with Calle 21, Santa Cruz

Confirm the order
Verify the order is created
Verify the checkout flow completes
